extracted.name: Cucumber Salad
extracted.description: This cucumber salad recipe features thinly sliced cucumbers, red onion, fresh dill, and a sweet and tangy vinegar dressing. Cooling and refreshing, this summer salad is a perfect BBQ or picnic side dish.
ingredient_lines: ½ large red onion (very thinly sliced)
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, toss together the cucumber, onion, vinegar, honey, and salt. Chill for 20 minutes.
Transfer to a serving bowl, leaving any excess water behind. Sprinkle with the dill and chives, if desired. Season with several grinds of pepper and serve.
